activities.title: Activity 1 — 10 min
lines: In pairs, identify 3 information systems you use at university.
For each: people, hardware, software, data, networks.
What information does each system produce?

activities.title: Activity 2 — 10 min
lines: Choose one engineering system.
Identify its input, processing, output, storage and control.
Share one example with the class.

activities.title: Activity 3 — 10 min: “IS or IT?” — classify 5 examples and explain your reasoning.
Activity A — choose the tool (15 min)
lines: In small groups, choose a suitable programming tool for:
1. A robot controller.
2. Engineering data analysis.
3. Numerical simulation.
Give one reason for each choice.

activities.title: Activity B — follow the system (15 min)
lines: For a temperature-control system, identify:
• Input device
• Processing component
• Memory or storage needed
• Software involved
• Output or action
Explain how the parts work together.

activities.title: Key points
lines: • You need to keep a large CAD project when the computer is turned off. What resource?
• A running simulation needs temporary working space. What resource?
• A device measures temperature and sends the value to a computer. What hardware role?
• What software manages files, memory, devices and applications?
• Which is an application: Windows, RAM, MATLAB or CPU?

activities.title: Activity A — model the data (15 min)
lines: In small groups, design a simple database for a university engineering laboratory.
Identify 3 entities, 3–5 attributes for each, and at least one relationship.

activities.title: Activity B — spot the file problem (15 min)
lines: A machine’s location is copied into four separate files. The machine moves, but only two files are updated.
Explain the problem and propose a database-based solution.

activities.title: Key points
lines: • Put these in order from smallest to largest: database, character, file, field, record.
• Give one example of an entity and two attributes.
• Name two problems caused by keeping separate files.
• What does a DBMS do?
• Explain the difference between a data warehouse and a data mart.
• Why is a primary key useful?

activities.title: Activity 1 — predict the output (10 min)
lines: Without running it, predict the output:
`x = 4 print(x + 3) print(x * 2)`
Then run the code and compare.

activities.title: Activity 2 — engineering task (20 min)
lines: Write a short program that stores three sensor readings in a list and prints each reading.
Extension: calculate and display the average.
Work in pairs and explain each line.

activities.title: Key points
lines: • Write a program that displays your name and engineering programme.
• Store a length in metres and display it in centimetres.
• Ask the user for a temperature and convert it to Fahrenheit.
• Use if/else to classify a measurement as above or below a chosen limit.
• Create a list of three measurements and print each one using a loop.

platform_questions.prompt: نظام المعلومات (IS) هو:
options: تجميع منظم من الناس والعتاد والبرمجيات والشبكات والبيانات
platform_questions.explanation: IS = تجميع منظم من الناس والعتاد والبرمجيات وشبكات الاتصالات وموارد البيانات.

platform_questions.prompt: الفرق بين IS و IT:
options: IS إطار أوسع بيضم IT مع الناس والعمليات
platform_questions.explanation: IS يشمل الناس والعمليات مع التقنية؛ IT هو التقنية نفسها (عتاد، برمجيات، شبكات).

platform_questions.prompt: من موارد IS الخمسة:
platform_questions.explanation: الموارد الخمسة: People, Hardware, Software, Data, Networks.

platform_questions.prompt: أنشطة النظام الأساسية:
platform_questions.explanation: النشاطات: الإدخال، المعالجة، المخرجات، والتغذية الراجعة والتحكم.

platform_questions.prompt: مثال على TPS:
platform_questions.explanation: ATM نظام معالجة معاملات (TPS) — يتحقق من PIN ويصرف ويحدّث الرصيد.

platform_questions.prompt: نظام التحكم في العمليات PCS بيregulated:
options: متغيرات فيزيائية زي الحرارة والضغط والتدفق
platform_questions.explanation: PCS بتراقب وتنظم متغيرات فيزيائية في المنشآت الصناعية.

platform_questions.prompt: مثال على MIS:
platform_questions.explanation: SAP ERP من أشهر أمثلة نظم معلومات الإدارة (MIS).

platform_questions.prompt: في التسجيل الجامعي، وظيفة التحكم (Control) بتتمثل في:
options: القواعد والفحوص اللي بتتحكم في عملية التسجيل
platform_questions.explanation: التحكم = القواعد والفحوص اللي بتضمن سير العملية صح.

platform_questions.prompt: تحدٍّ أخلاقي من تحديات IT:
platform_questions.explanation: التحديات: Privacy, Accuracy, Intellectual Property, Security, Responsible Use.

platform_questions.prompt: المهندس محتاج يفهم IS لأن:
options: قراراته بقت معتمدة على بيانات وبرامج وشبكات وهو بيشتغل جوه منظمات معتمدة عليها
platform_questions.explanation: المهندس بيستخدم IS في التصميم والتصنيع والصيانة وإدارة المشاريع واتخاذ القرار.

platform_questions.prompt: Which sequence lists the typical activities of a system?
options: Input, Processing, Output, Feedback and control
platform_questions.explanation: Typical system activities include: Input — capturing and assembling elements that enter the system; Processing — transforming inputs into outputs; Output — delivering the results to their destination; Feedback and control — monitoring performance and guiding the system. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 4)

platform_questions.prompt: In the engineering-system example, what is the INPUT?
platform_questions.explanation: INPUT: Sensor measurements. PROCESSING: Controller / algorithm. OUTPUT: Actuator / action. FEEDBACK: Measured response. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 5)

platform_questions.prompt: Which statement best describes Information Technology (IT)?
options: Technology used to support information processing: hardware, software, networks and related technologies
The complete set of resources and activities used to deliver information
Only the people who use a system
Only the data stored in a database
platform_questions.explanation: IT is a major part of an information system—not the whole system. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 7)

platform_questions.prompt: How many major IS resources does the lecture identify?
platform_questions.explanation: The Five Major IS Resources: PEOPLE — Users & specialists; HARDWARE — Physical devices; SOFTWARE — Instructions & programs; DATA — Facts & observations; NETWORKS — Communication resources. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 8)

platform_questions.prompt: What are the five activities an Information System performs?
platform_questions.explanation: 1 INPUT 2 PROCESS 3 OUTPUT 4 STORAGE 5 CONTROL. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 9)

platform_questions.prompt: Which of these is an Operations Support System?
platform_questions.explanation: Operations Support Systems: Transaction Processing Systems (TPS), Process Control Systems (PCS), Enterprise Collaboration Systems. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 11)

platform_questions.prompt: What does a Transaction Processing System (TPS) do?
options: Collects, stores, modifies, and retrieves routine daily business transactions
Monitors and regulates physical variables like temperature, pressure, and flow rates
platform_questions.explanation: A Transaction Processing System (TPS) is a software-based information system that collects, stores, modifies, and retrieves routine daily business transactions. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 12)

platform_questions.prompt: What does a Process Control System (PCS) monitor and regulate?
options: Physical variables like temperature, pressure, and flow rates
platform_questions.explanation: A Process Control System (PCS) is an industrial automation network that monitors and regulates physical variables like temperature, pressure, and flow rates. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 14)

platform_questions.prompt: Which ethical challenge asks «who should have access to personal or organizational data?»
platform_questions.explanation: Privacy — who should have access to personal or organizational data? (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 19)

platform_questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT one of the three Quick Practice examples?
platform_questions.explanation: Quick Practice: What Is the Information System? University LMS, Smart Factory, Online Store. (IT_lecture_1_2026.pdf, p. 22)
